programme.title: China Bound: Chengdu
programme.desc: Tianran spends 3 days in Chengdu, the capital of Sichuan Province and UNESCO's first City of Gastronomy. He dives deep into Chengdu culture, exploring the infamous "mala" numbing and spicy flavors of Sichuanese street food and hotpot, and visiting historical attractions like Wuhou Shrine, Du Fu's Thatched Cottage, and the Jinsha Site Museum, which houses exquisite relics from a 3,000-year-old kingdom uncovered beneath the streets of Chengdu. Of course, no visit to this city is complete without seeing giant pandas and enjoying a cup of tea while getting your ears cleaned in the iconic People's Park. After all, when in Chengdu, do as the locals do.

programme.title: Aerial China II Ep.5
programme.desc: Guangdong, sheltered by the Nanling Mountains, is a province where rivers cascade from hills on their way to the ocean. But before they meet the sea, they pass through another land of plenty, a place where solid earth encounters the rolling waves in a truly loving embrace - the Pearl River Delta.

programme.title: Dream Builders: Stories from China and Europe
programme.sub-title: Dream Builders: Stories from China and Europe
programme.desc: On the occasion of the 50th anniversary of diplomatic relations between China and the EU, Inheritors of China launches a special multimedia series titled “Dream Builders: Stories from China and Europe.” Taking culture as the starting point, the series responds to public discourse by telling the real-life stories of Europeans living in China. Through their perspectives, it vividly illustrates how tradition and modernity spark mutual inspiration between China and Europe—showcasing a relationship of shared growth, empowerment, and enduring partnership. The series travels through cities including Beijing, Shanghai, Jinan, and Datong, focusing on Europeans of different ages and professions—from programming and installation art to music, calligraphy, and martial arts. Their lived experiences offer fresh insight into how cultural exchange between China and Europe continues to gain vitality, and how mutual learning between civilizations breathes lasting life into practical cooperation.

programme.title: Chengdu Lacquerware Art
programme.desc: Chengdu lacquerware is unique, thanks to its “three carvings and one engraving” technique. Along with its bold decorative style, this has made it a gem of Chinese lacquer art. Chengdu lacquerware also emphasizes the use of vibrant colors. Pieces are brought to beautiful life by bright red, vivid yellow, emerald green, and other striking hues.

programme.title: A Sip of Mount Wuyi
programme.desc: Wuyi rock tea, nurtured in the mineral-rich cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains, is a distinctive oolong embodying a unique "rock rhyme" (yan yun)—a taste of nature's harmony. More than a beverage, teas like Da Hong Pao invite mindful appreciation, reflecting centuries of tradition and a philosophy of patience in their complex roasted notes and enduring aftertaste. Discover the terroir, meticulous processing, and the spirit of Chinese tea culture within these exceptional leaves.

programme.title: Ding Porcelain Firing
programme.desc: In ancient times, skilled craftsmen combined clay with fire and, using nothing more than their hands and wisdom, created the history of porcelain. A thousand years ago, at the time of the Northern Song Dynasty, a type of porcelain was produced that stood out for its exquisite quality, elegant coloring and beautiful patterns. This was Ding porcelain, and it became a favorite at the imperial court. However, within 200 years, amid the chaos of constant warfare, the art of making it was lost. The dazzling white light of the Ding kilns had faded, seemingly forever. And yet, 800 years later, that light has been reignited.

programme.title: China Bound: Chongqing
programme.desc: Join us in southwest China's Chongqing, one of the world's biggest cities. From futuristic skylines and cyberpunk streets, to fire-breathing opera, spicy hotpot and kungfu tea, we're diving deep into this megacity the size of Austria.

programme.title: China Bound: Guangzhou
programme.desc: Join us in Guangzhou, a global manufacturing hub in south China with a population as large as New York’s. From browsing hip street markets to wholesale clothes shopping, sampling world-famous Cantonese cuisine, and visiting the childhood home of kungfu legend Bruce Lee, there is plenty to do during our stay.

programme.title: China Bound: Wuhan
programme.desc: Tianran He visits Wuhan, a megacity at the crossroads of central China. From experiencing its vibrant breakfast culture and iconic dishes like hot dry noodles to exploring the lakes and hills of the expansive East Lake, as well as historic districts that showcase a blend of Chinese and Western architecture, Tianran uncovers why Wuhan has been a pivotal city in Chinese history for centuries. programme.title: Celebrating the Corban Festival
programme.desc: Kashgar, situated in the southwest of Xinjiang, was a key stop on the ancient Silk Road. It served as a gateway for trade between China and countries in Asia and Europe. However, it wasn’t only goods that were exchanged on the Silk Road. So, too, were cultures, which merged and flourished. In the 7th century AD, Islam entered China’s western regions along the Silk Road, bringing with it the Corban Festival. With time, Corban became more than a religious festival. It developed into a traditional holiday celebrated by everyone in Kashgar. Corban is as important as New Year. Kashgar locals load their tables with food on this day to reward themselves for a year of hard work. Corban is all about sharing. In the past, rich families would buy extra meat to share with their neighbors and friends. This tradition is still alive in Kashgar today, although it’s practiced not just by the rich, but pretty well everyone.

programme.title: Woodworkers Guild of America presented by CraftsyTV
programme.desc: In the episode "Easy Projects with Native Materials," the focus is on crafting robust furniture using natural materials, bringing joy to woodworking enthusiasts. The project kicks off with a stool build using one-inch dowels for rails and sturdy legs crafted from one-and-a-half-inch square pieces. A standout feature is the woven seat, initially demonstrated with bundling twine but showcased with Cecil rope for its natural charm and durability. The construction process begins meticulously, drilling precise holes using a drill press for consistent alignment. Offset holes on adjacent faces accommodate the rails snugly, while chamfered ends prevent any interference during assembly. Dry-fitting ensures all components fit seamlessly before applying glue, guaranteeing a sturdy final product. After assembly, the stool is clamped securely to maintain square alignment and left to dry before sanding and finishing bring out the wood's natural beauty. The seat weaving process is a highlight, with the speaker demonstrating how to wrap Cecil rope around the frame in a precise pattern, creating a durable and visually appealing seat. Throughout, the importance of precision and the handy use of pliers for control during weaving are emphasized. The episode also explores comparisons between stools made from different materials, celebrating the diversity of woodworking choices. Transitioning to a coffee table project, the speaker selects wood pieces with a striking blue stain for added visual interest. Techniques for drilling and joint fitting are expertly demonstrated, ensuring the table frame is not just sturdy but also artistically crafted. Challenges encountered, such as uneven surfaces or knots in the tabletop, are met with practical solutions, including finishing tips with Danish oil for a natural, lustrous look. Throughout the tutorial, the joy of working with native materials and the satisfaction of creating beautiful, enduring furniture pieces shine through, making it a delightful watch for woodworking enthusiasts of all skill levels.

programme.title: The High
programme.desc: THE HIGH is a feature length documentary film about the making of the longest high altitude foot race in the world. The film follows the path of a group of extreme runners who individually decide to take part of a dangerous running experiment gone wrong. Indian race director Rajat Chauhan works against the advice of the military, his family and friends to create a race over the two highest passes in the world (above 17 500ft). The decline begins from the start, with runners collapsing from dehydration, hypothermia, and high-altitude sickness. And by its end finds the entire race in jeopardy and the prospect that no one finishes. Brought to life by archive footage, story recreations, and interviews, the film unfolds the events in the Himalayas of Northern India and gives a unique look into the lives of the extreme marathon runners involved. Uncovering the avalanches, athletes, and the high altitude elements. THE HIGH shows the rewards of determination, the dangers of obsession, and in the end leaves you with the answer of why they called it, the toughest race on earth. Directed by Barry Walton.

programme.title: The Trail S1 - "Relocation"
programme.desc: Laramy realizes that game is scarce because of the wolves and he decides to put some distance between himself and the pack. Time to break down camp and move to a new location.

programme.title: The Trail S1 - "White Death"
programme.desc: Snow, what the mountain men called white death, stops Laramy in his tracks. In addition, his trusty horse Seven has suffered a leg injury. Laramy must take care of Seven, battle through hunger, and survive the snowfall.

programme.title: The Trail S1 - "The Struggle"
programme.desc: Laramy remains stuck at Camp Hell Hole, nursing 7's leg, and struggling to survive in the freezing temperatures without food.

programme.title: Dropped S1 - "Edge of the Earth"
programme.desc: De eerste aflevering is een inleiding tot de reis van Chris en Casey, met details over het landschap, de weersomstandigheden en de manieren van jagen die ze zullen moeten toepassen. Er wordt ook ingegaan op de achtergrond van het project en de oorsprong ervan.

programme.title: Dropped S1 - "On Top of the World"
programme.desc: Chris en Casey doorkruisen rivieren, veenlanden en bergen op jacht naar een enorme elandstier. Chris bezeert zijn knie en twijfelt aan zijn volhardingsvermogen.

programme.title: Dropped S1 - "The River Migration"
programme.desc: Het duo gaat stroomafwaarts op jacht naar de mannetjeseland, waarbij ze in twee dagen bijna 32 kilometer afleggen. Ze zetten hun elandkamp uiteindelijk op, ondanks een verontrustende ontmoeting met een dichtbij levende grizzly.

programme.title: Fight to Survive S3 - "Mountain Lion Attack"
programme.desc: Marinier Anne Hjelle was aan het mountainbiken toen ze van haar fiets werd gerukt door een bergleeuw. Anne vocht terug, terwijl de grote kat haar gezicht met zijn kaken vermorzelde. De aanval was nog maar het begin van Anne's ongelooflijke strijd om te overleven.

programme.title: Fight to Survive S3 - "Soul Of A Survivor"
programme.desc: Craig DeMartino onderzoekt de verhalen van andere overlevenden die hij in de loop van het seizoen heeft ontmoet. Hun overlevingsverhalen zijn allemaal verschillend, maar Craig ontdekt dat deze overlevenden meer overeenkomsten hebben dan je zou denken.

programme.title: The New Fly Fisher S16 - "Tuckamore Lodge (Newfoundland)"
programme.desc: Colin McKeown bezoekt een van de mooiste streken van Newfoundland om op zalm te vissen en om walvissen, kariboes en ander wild te spotten.

programme.title: The New Fly Fisher S16 - "Wind River Fly Fishing (Wyoming)"
programme.desc: Mark Melnyk vist op cutthroatforel en andere forelsoorten op enkele van de mooiste plekken in Wyoming.

programme.title: The New Fly Fisher S16 - "Igloo Lake Lodge (Labrador)"
programme.desc: Vliegvissen op grote beekforel en zalm.

programme.title: Wardens S5 - "True Lies"
programme.desc: Een controlepost buiten Billings houdt een man aan die weigert de waarheid te vertellen. Onderzoek naar wie het hert heeft geschoten, onthult een lange geschiedenis van wildovertredingen.

programme.title: Wardens S5 - "Head Case"
programme.desc: Iemand heeft het hoofd van een trofee-wapiti geschoten en verstopt. Beheerders besteden maanden aan het observeren van het hoofd. Zodra het wordt verplaatst, gebruiken ze hightechapparatuur om het hoofd te lokaliseren en de verdachte te pakken.

programme.title: Wardens S5 - "Blood Trail"
programme.desc: Wildbeheerders stappen deze week de wereld van CSI binnen om te achterhalen waar een hert is gedood. Maar om de waarheid te achterhalen, is het beste om het bloedspoor te volgen.

programme.title: The Urban Huntsman S1 - "Chamois"
programme.desc: Dit verhaal gaat over de bergen, ongerepte natuur, de zoektocht naar stilte – en een paar bijzonder behendige geiten.

programme.title: The Urban Huntsman S1 - "Become NatureWise"
programme.desc: De missie van de organisatie is om bij kinderen een natuurverbonden identiteit en begrip van de natuur te ontwikkelen, door kennis te delen over natuur, jacht en hengelsport – én door te koken met wat de natuur te bieden heeft: planten, vis en wild.

programme.title: The Urban Huntsman S1 - "The Tuscan Boar"
programme.desc: Ontdek een meestermessenmaker, jaag op wilde zwijnen in de heuvels en ervaar de charme van een bekroond kasteel.

programme.title: Buccaneers and Bones S1 - "Fighting Fish"
programme.desc: Hengelsportexperts Lori-Ann Murphy en Aaron Adams bewijzen dat het vangen van een tarpoen niet eenvoudig is, wanneer ze een Atlantische tarpoen proberen te vangen in Florida Keys. Dokter Jerry Ault bediscussieert het onderzoek dat wetenschappers doen om de mysteries van deze vissen te ontrafelen.

programme.title: Buccaneers and Bones S1 - "Tippets & Leaders"
programme.desc: Het doel van het team om een volwassen tarpon te vangen en te merken is vervuld, want een van hen haalt een Atlantische tarpoen van 28 kilogram binnen. Michael Keaton en Yvon Choulnard waden ondertussen samen verder door de wadden. Ook blikken we terug op de geweldige visweek in Belize.

programme.title: The Trail S1 - "On the Move"
programme.desc: Laramy and 7 leave camp Hell Hole and hit the trail again. They are headed for lower elevation in search of a more permanent place to call home.

programme.title: The Trail S1 - "Permanent Residence"
programme.desc: Laramy and 7 find a long term camping spot out of the snow and at a lower elevation. Laramy gets to work making a more permanent shelter and looking for food.

programme.title: The Trail S1 - "Focused on Food"
programme.desc: Laramy locates some whitetail deer and focuses his efforts on hunting them.

programme.title: Dropped S1 - "Night Stalkers"
programme.desc: Uitgeput en hongerig vervolgen de broers hun weg stroomafwaarts, terwijl ze nauwelijks energie hebben om hun kamp op te zetten. Ze vinden een overvloed aan tekenen van elanden en een gunstig terrein voor hun habitat.

programme.title: Dropped S1 - "Exploration Camp"
programme.desc: Dagen gaan voorbij, maar de elanden zijn ongrijpbaar sinds dag elf. Ze doorstaan rusteloze nachten met rondsluipende beesten. Dan vinden ze een verlaten pelsjagershut, waar een enorme grizzlybeer woont.

programme.title: Dropped S1 - "Prayer Point 2"
programme.desc: Op de derde dag van de rivierreis zijn ze wanhopig op zoek naar een jagerskamp om hun moraal op te vijzelen en de enorme elandstier te kunnen achtervolgen. De frustratie neemt toe als de broers voor het eerst hun twijfels opbiechten.

programme.title: Madfin Shark Series S1 - "Day One Pt. 1"
programme.desc: Dag één begint als de vier tweepersoonsteams vertrekken vanuit de Hurricane Hole Marina in Key West met negen verschillende camera's waaronder helikopter- en onderwatercamera's die alle actie filmen.

programme.title: The New Fly Fisher S16 - "Island Park (Idaho)"
programme.desc: Forelvissen op drift in Idaho.

programme.title: The New Fly Fisher S16 - "Gander River Outfitters (Newfoundland)"
programme.desc: Laat in het seizoen vissen op Atlantische zalm op de beroemde Gander River in het oosten van Newfoundland.

programme.title: Wardens S5 - "Case Closed"
programme.desc: De illegale jacht op meerdere dieren door een familie van stropers in de afgelopen vijf jaar komt nu voor de rechter. Wildbeheerders staan op de getuigenbank in de hoop op een veroordeling en een “Case Closed”.

programme.title: Wardens S6 - "Law Dodgers"
programme.desc: Wachtmeester Bryan Golie van regio 4 zet de achtervolging in op jagers die een wildcontrolepost omzeilden. Een bijna vier uur durend onderzoek onthult precies wat ze verborgen hielden.

programme.title: Survival Science S1 - "Surviving a Bear Attack"
programme.desc: Nick en Laura creëren interessante tests om de immense kracht en verbazingwekkende snelheid van grizzlyberen te onderzoeken. Ze gebruiken stuntgereedschap uit Hollywood om een aanval na te bootsen. Daarna proberen ze een wonderlijk pijlschot te recreëren dat een man redde van de dood door een berenaanval.

programme.title: Survival Science S1 - "Surviving Treestand Accidents"
programme.desc: In deze spannende aflevering komen we te weten hoe ongelukken vanuit een boom-uitzichtpunt kunnen gebeuren en hoe we ze kunnen voorkomen. Onze gastheren, het stuntteam en de crash dummies worden blootgesteld aan dynamische experimenten, waarbij ze naar de grond geslingerd worden in de naam der wetenschap.

programme.title: The Urban Huntsman S1 - "The Ghost of Transylvania"
programme.desc: Beklim de wilde pieken in het door verhalen doorzeefde Karpatengebergte, de thuisbasis van de beroemdste jager van allemaal, Dracula!

programme.title: The Urban Huntsman S1 - "The Bavarian Wolf in Hungary"
programme.desc: Reis naar de glooiende heuvels rond het Balatonmeer in Hongarije en verken samen met een gepassioneerde jager de mogelijkheden om een biodivers agrarisch landschap nieuw leven in te blazen.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild S1 - "Alpine Ghosts"
programme.desc: Mario beklimt de gevaarlijke bergen van het zuidelijke eiland van Nieuw-Zeeland tijdens een vermoeiende jacht op damherten met zijn pijl-en-boog. Hij kookt een heerlijke taart met hertenvlees van het hert dat hij heeft kunnen verzamelen.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild S1 - "Deadly Outback"
programme.desc: We zijn in de outback van Australië en het is het regenseizoen. Mario gaat samen met een oude vriend op zoek naar een wilde buffel en probeert in het niemandsland een verbazingwekkend Zuid-Amerikaans gerecht te bereiden.

programme.title: Dropped S1 - "King of the Tundra"
programme.desc: Casey schiet een enorme elandstier neer bij de rivier. Een andere stier nadert vervolgens, wat leidt tot een gespannen patstelling aan de overkant van de rivier.

programme.title: Dropped S1 - "The Day After"
programme.desc: "Na het doden van een reusachtige elandstier, weten Chris en Casey de eland van 680 kilogram

programme.title: Police Patrol S1 - "EUROPEAN POLICE PATROLS"
programme.desc: In de multiculturele centra van Parijs en Londen kunnen de spanningen hoog oplopen. Het is aan de politie om de verschillen te overbruggen en de vrede te bewaren - dagelijks aan het werk om enkele van de drukste hoofdsteden van Europa te beschermen.

programme.title: Police Patrol S1 - "WOMEN POLICE PATROLS"
programme.desc: In Hyderabad, India, bestaan rijkdom en armoede naast elkaar. Elke dag strijden 15,000 agenten tegen criminaliteit variërend van diefstal tot interreligieus geweld. In Palestina staan 8,500 politieagenten voor een nog grotere uitdaging: werken in een gefragmenteerd, politiek gespannen landschap waar elke patrouille risico's met zich meebrengt.

programme.title: Police Patrol S1 - "MEDITERRANEAN - HARBOUR POLICE PATROLS"
programme.desc: In Catalonië heeft de regionale politie het overgenomen van de Spaanse nationale politie en een snelle-reactie-eenheid op motoren ingezet om de stedelijke criminaliteit aan te pakken. Ondertussen werkt de politie in Haifa, de belangrijkste havenstad van Israël, volgens strenge wetten in een gespannen omgeving die wordt gevormd door terrorismedreigingen en het voortdurende regionale conflicten.

programme.title: The New Fly Fisher S16 - "Big River Camps (Labrador)"
programme.desc: Labrador Atlantische zalmvissen op ongerepte wateren.

programme.title: The New Fly Fisher S16 - "Como Lake Resort (Northern Ontario)"
programme.desc: Op jacht naar grote smallmouthbaarzen en snoeken.

programme.title: The New Fly Fisher S16 - "Hawk Lake Lodge (Sunset Country)"
programme.desc: Vissen op baars tijdens een koudefront.

programme.title: Wardens S6 - "Crying Shame"
programme.desc: Wachtmeester Nick Taylor van regio 5 komt in het vizier wanneer een jager een wapen recht op hem richt. En in regio 2 ontdekken de wachters een jageres met een geheim dat ze verbergt.

programme.title: Wardens S6 - "Illegal Possession"
programme.desc: Wachtmeesters van Regio 3 achtervolgen een loper van de controlepost en ontdekken dat de jagers een hert hebben geschoten – maar wat en waar is de vraag?

programme.title: Wardens S6 - "Under Fire"
programme.desc: De droogte in Montana dreigt de jacht en visserij in de Treasure State stil te leggen. Maar dode vissen en beperkingen zijn het minste van de zorgen van de wachters wanneer de beren de stad binnenkomen.

programme.title: Madfin Shark Series S1 - "Day One Pt. 2"
programme.desc: Dag één gaat verder terwijl de vier teams op zoek gaan naar reusachtige hongerige haaien in de prachtige wateren voor de kust van Key West, Florida.

programme.title: Madfin Shark Series S1 - "Day Two Pt. 1"
programme.desc: Dag twee van het Madfin Shark Series-toernooi begint, en het wordt steeds duidelijker welke van onze vier tweepersoonsteams er alles aan moeten doen om niet op de laatste plaats te eindigen en te worden geëlimineerd. In de Hurricane Hole Marina in Key West zijn de haaien op zoek naar de schippers.

programme.title: Dangers of Dark Fest S2 - "Episode 2"
programme.desc: In this episode we discover the fanaticism of the riders. How do they achieve their success during such a dangerous event? The answer turns out to be friendship.

programme.title: Our Auto Expert S1 - "Episode Ten"
programme.desc: Nik praises the 2021 Audi e-tron Sportback. Mike talks about the return of the coupe SUV with the Infiniti QX55. Nik tests the Lamborghini Huracan EVO and explores the 2021 hybrid Wrangler 4XE.

programme.title: Our Auto Expert S1 - "Episode Eleven"
programme.desc: Nik explores the Mazda CX30 Turbo and Toyota 4Runner. He highlights the 2022 VW IDA and off-roads in the Hyundai Santa Cruz. Hopes are high for the Lexus LF-Z Concept Electric.

programme.title: Our Auto Expert S1 - "Episode Twelve"
programme.desc: Nik praises the 2021 Lincoln Aviator GT Hybrid. Mike showcases the 2021 Audi Q5. Nik explains Jeep's luxury transformation of the Wagoneer. He tests the hands-free drive of the 2022 Chevy Bolt SUV.

programme.title: Gymkhana Grid Profiles S1 - "Nicolett Szanto"
programme.desc: Hungarian Gymkhana Champion Nikolett Szanto is one of the sport’s few professional drivers. Balancing racing career with her day job is just one of the many.

programme.title: Gymkhana Grid Profiles S1 - "Dmitrij Sribnyj"
programme.desc: Dmitrij Sribnyj reveals his story for the first time from his evacuation during the 1986 Chernobyl nuclear disaster to becoming a 4-time Gymkhana Grid champion.

programme.title: Gymkhana Grid Profiles S1 - "Luke Woodham v Adam Elder"
programme.desc: 3-time rear wheel drive Gymkhana Grid champion Luke Woodham is defending for a fourth title. His biggest rival Adam Elder is doing everything he can to win.

programme.title: Inside the Masters of Dirt S2 - "New Beginnings"
programme.desc: To kick off this season of Inside Masters of Dirt, you’ll get to know the legendary M.O.D riders, their stories, and the iconic Vienna shows that forged their legacy as the world’s wildest athletes.

programme.title: Inside the Masters of Dirt S2 - "When it Rains, it Pours"
programme.desc: In Beirut, the Masters of Dirt crew prepare to put on yet another epic show in the Middle East. But even in the hottest countries - when it rains, it pours! See why this tour stop goes down as one of the most challenging in recent M.O.D history!

programme.title: Inside the Masters of Dirt S2 - "Wibmer’s Wonderland"
programme.desc: What starts as a business trip to Innsbruck for Georgie and Bienve, turns into a reunion with MTB icon - Fabio Wibmer. Discover how the YouTube superstar lives, how Georgie overcomes his fears, and witness some of the most epic riding of the season.

programme.title: King of the Hammers: The Ultra4 Saga S1 - "To Hell and Back"
programme.desc: Last year's champion, Erik Miller defends his title. While 2nd place finisher, Jason Scherer, will be one of the many top challengers aiming to beat him.

programme.title: King of the Hammers: The Ultra4 Saga S1 - "Finding the Line"
programme.desc: We follow Shannon Campbell, the first 3-time champion of the King of the Hammers. But his kids, also young drivers, push their dad to the brink of his limits.

programme.title: King of the Hammers: The Ultra4 Saga S1 - "Bringing Out The Big Guns"
programme.desc: It's mud, sweat, and gears as drivers battle it out in the toughest Ultra 4 race yet.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz S7 - "Firepower Operation"
programme.desc: It's nearing the end of Operation Firepower. The ghouls are working hard to complete the project and tries to fire up the 'Cuda for the first time.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz S7 - "Disneyland of Carz"
programme.desc: At SEMA, the Ghouls make their rounds in the Disneyland of cars. The team goes drifting and Mark takes to the stage to reveal Operation Firepower to the world.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz S7 - "The Phantom ‘Cuda Rides Again"
programme.desc: The legendary 1971 440 six-barrel, Phantom 'Cuda is revealed to its owner. Don't miss the final send-off for the 'Cuda that started Graveyard Carz.

programme.title: Geared Up S1 - "The Blazer"
programme.desc: A 1970 K5 Chevrolet Blazer undergoes a transformation with new paint, interior, and a diesel engine conversion.

programme.title: Geared Up S1 - "Shelly"
programme.desc: A neglected 1981 Porsche 911 SC is brought back to life and restored to its original factory specifications.

programme.title: MTB Heroes S3 - "Morocco"
programme.desc: A German MTB legend decides to build a van and travel all the way down to Morocco to explore and ride the great Atlas mountains.

programme.title: MTB Heroes S3 - "Spain"
programme.desc: We meet with a Spanish MTB pro rider who decided to create his own company in order to build the most exclusive and unique carbon bikes.

programme.title: Fast and Famous S1 - "Fast and Famous"
programme.desc: Racing Driver Arie Luyendyk Jr. challenges two celebrities, kickboxer Rico Verhoeven and footballer Sol Campbell, to see who is the fastest around the track.

programme.title: The Flying Kestrel S1 - "Stripped"
programme.desc: Meet Nigel McNally and the team from Kestrel Beer who has hopes of breaking the land speed record in a restored 1930’a Riley Kestrel 9.

programme.title: The Flying Kestrel S1 - "Dyno Test"
programme.desc: The record attempt is only one week away and everything seems to be on track, until the results of a dyno test put a spanner in the works.

programme.title: Find Me A Classic S1 - "Morgan"
programme.desc: Mat’s demanding client Gordon is in search of a Morgan, but will he be able to find the ideal car for the right price?

programme.title: Find Me A Classic S1 - "Citroen DS"
programme.desc: Mat goes in search of a perfect Citroen DS for Leon, a man who has strong connections to the DS, and to France.

programme.title: Born To S1 - "Edgar Torronteras"
programme.desc: A true godfather of his sport, Edgar Torronteras, has pioneered FMX and is without a doubt one of the key men responsible for making it what it is today.

programme.title: Born To S1 - "Nani Roma"
programme.desc: Nani Roma has raced cars and bikes in his professional career. However, Nani doesn't race in normal competitions on normal circuits. He races in the Dakar Rally.

programme.title: Our Auto Expert S1 - "Episode Thirteen"
programme.desc: Nik explores BMW's electrified future. Mike off-roads in the Nissan Titan Pro-4X. Cadillac shines with the new Escalade. Nik highlights Toyota Tundra's value. He enjoys the Jeep Wrangler Rubicon 392.

programme.title: Gymkhana Grid Profiles S1 - "Great 8"
programme.desc: Road to Gymkhana Grid: 100% pure adrenalin! Profiling 8 of the sport’s top drivers, we see into their minds and the mental preparation needed to compete.

programme.title: FMX Nomads S1 - "FMX Nomads"
programme.desc: Join Dan Whitby, Samson Eaton and Arran Powley for a day in the life of globetrotting freestyle motocross team, Bolddog.

programme.title: Supercar Showdown S2 - "Meet the Contestants"
programme.desc: V8 Supercar legends Rick and Todd Kelly have scoured Australia and the world for drivers from all walks of life. Over eleven eventful weeks our ten rookie drivers will face off in a series of sudden death challenges.

programme.title: Supercar Showdown S2 - "Lap Consistency"
programme.desc: Although all ten contestants narrowly escaped elimination last week, two contestants were put on notice and for them the reality of elimination starts to sink in.

programme.title: Supercar Showdown S2 - "Braking Challenge"
programme.desc: It’s week three and the contestants are preparing for a new round of challenges.

programme.title: Supercar Showdown S2 - "Driver Changes"
programme.desc: It’s week four and the contestants are preparing for a new round of challenges...and for our eight remaining rookies the elimination room looms.

programme.title: The Ultimate Rider S1 - "Slow Speed"
programme.desc: To test the rookies’ fundamental skills of accelerating, braking, and cornering, Moto GP legend Daryl Beattie and Team Honda Racing boss Paul Free have designed both a skills session and a points challenge.

programme.title: The Ultimate Rider S1 - "21st Birthday"
programme.desc: Which contestant can get the furthest on 500ml of fuel while maintaining a set race speed? Can Glenn take out top spot and receive the best birthday present he could ask for?

programme.title: Graveyard Carz S11 - "Taking Home the Bronze"
programme.desc: See the beautiful Turbine-Bonze Metallic 1968 Charger meticulously resurrected and revealed to its proud owner.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz S11 - "Hellephant in the Room"
programme.desc: At SEMA 2018, Mark was gifted the first third-generation 426 Hemi-Crate engine by Mopar, and now must decide which car he’s going to install it in for SEMA 2019. Meanwhile, Will begins paint-prep on a beautiful Rallye Red 1970 Plymouth ‘Cuda.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz S11 - "Rallye the Troops"
programme.desc: Mark leaves Will in charge of the shop while working on his super-secret SEMA 2019 build. This leaves George and Dougie to begin the final assembly to the 1970 B7 Challenger. In the body shop, a 1970 'Cuda is prepped for its first-coat of Rallye Red.

programme.title: MTB Heroes S3 - "Bali"
programme.desc: We travel to Bali - Indonesia to meet an MTB pro rider who decided to start a new life dividing his time between surfing and riding active volcanos.

programme.title: MTB Heroes S3 - "New Zealand"
programme.desc: We meet one of the most famous MTB photographers in New Zealand and follow him during the biggest MTB competition in Rotorua.

programme.title: Geared Up S1 - "Cabriolet"
programme.desc: A ruined and rested family heirloom 1962 Mercedes Benz 220 SE Cabriolet gets a restoration modification with a new Mercedes engine and a new interior with heated seats.

programme.title: Wild Walk S1 - "Seals"
programme.desc: A conservation success story, the Cape fur seal numbers are healthy. But this has paradoxically thrown up serious conservation issues from protecting endangered seabird nesting sites, conflict with fishermen and seal culling.

programme.title: Wild Walk S1 - "Sharks"
programme.desc: Will the greatest predator on earth survive our exploitation of the ocean and the mass slaughter for their fins? In this episode Swati walks with Sharks.

programme.title: Blue World S5 - "Sea Hunt Forever Festival"
programme.desc: In the Flower Garden Banks National Marine Sanctuary, Blue World investigates some of the densest coral reefs in the Caribbean as they spawn under cover of darkness.

programme.title: Blue World S5 - "Marine Biology in Turks & Caicos"
programme.desc: Blue World heads down to the shipwrecks of North Carolina (USA) to observe how these wrecks have become home to thousands of animals, including Sand Tiger sharks.

programme.title: Blue World S5 - "Shark’s “Tonic Immobility” in the Bahamas"
programme.desc: In a shark-filled adventure, Blue World travels to the Bahamas to meet Neal Harvey, a world-renown shark handler who will attempt to teach us how to put Caribbean Reef sharks into a relaxed state known as tonic immobility!

programme.title: Modern Migrations S1 - "The Reason"
programme.desc: In this episode we focus on the dynamics of the driving force of natural migrations. The seasonal movement of wild animals between pastures is a natural phenomenon, but not everywhere.

programme.title: Modern Migrations S1 - "The Human Touch"
programme.desc: The true meaning of conservation manifests when man and nature unite – separation is not an option. This episode focuses on the human involvement in what used to be a natural process.

programme.title: Modern Migrations S1 - "Kudu & Waterbuck"
programme.desc: In this episode we relocate two of the largest antelope species in Africa, the Kudu and the Waterbuck. Both these species require a helicopter and very competent ground crew.

programme.title: Keepers Of The Cape - The Issues S1 - "Responsible Fishing"
programme.desc: In this episode we look at the WWF Responsible Fisheries Programme. Dr. Samantha Petersen, the programme manager, tells exactly us what this entails and Tali dons her waterproofs and sets sail where she chats to fishermen and others in the industry.

programme.title: Keepers Of The Cape - The Issues S1 - "West Coast Marine Protected Area"
programme.desc: In this episode we show just how valuable this marine protected area is.Tali meets up with a group of scientists who are doing various studies so that they can assess the fish stocks and look at what role the mpa has in managing these stocks.

programme.title: Keepers Of The Cape - The Issues S1 - "De Hoop Marine Protected Area"
programme.desc: In this episode Tali explores the various creatures that reside in De Hoop Marine Protected Area, from the Greater White Pelicans and Chacma baboons to the large Eland.

programme.title: Orphans of the Wild S1 - "Baby Baboons"
programme.desc: When Shona, the injured baby baboon orphan, is introduced to her new friends, things don’t go all that smoothly.

programme.title: Orphans of the Wild S1 - "Signs in the Sand"
programme.desc: In trying to find a leopard in the vast desert landscape of southern Namibia, Marlice relies on the skills of Kiewiet - an expert Bushman tracker.

programme.title: Orphans of the Wild S1 - "Cat Trouble"
programme.desc: Establishing the hiararchy within a troop of adult baboons is serious business but when a wild leopard gets trapped the adrenalin really starts pumping.

programme.title: The Great Penguin Rescue S1 - "Episode 4"
programme.desc: As more starving penguin chicks are rescued, Michaela must work as hard as she can to keep the youngsters alive, but can she keep up with the pace as the birds keep on coming?

programme.title: The Great Penguin Rescue S1 - "Episode 5"
programme.desc: Michael needs to face her fears now and learn the critical task of hand feeding young birds. If she doesn’t, they will certainly die. But can she master the task in time?

programme.title: Python Hunters S1 - "The Perfect Storm"
programme.desc: The Python Hunters decide to tackle the debate over how the Burmese Pythons came to be established in the Everglades.

programme.title: Python Hunters S1 - "Dying to Survive"
programme.desc: A cold snap has hit the state of Florida and frigid temperatures are killing thousands of native and non-indigenous animals of all species. Has Mother Nature solved their python problem?

programme.title: Python Hunters S1 - "Everglades Under Siege"
programme.desc: The Florida Everglades are home to thousands of invasive plant, insect and animal species and yet the Burmese Python is perceived as the biggest concern. Are they a problem or is this snake hysteria?

programme.title: Adaptable Animals S1 - "Anything's Paws-sible"
programme.desc: Janice is being kept busy with a rare case of a dog who uses prosthetics on both front legs. A schnoodle with a ton of allergies and a rescued greyhound also seek help for some recent injuries, while a cart-using Pyrenees mix proves to be one stubborn pup.

programme.title: Saving the Mustang - America's Horse on the Brink
programme.sub-title: Saving the Mustang - America's Horse on the Brink
programme.desc: Saving The Mustang explores the state of wild horses today through the efforts of three individuals. All stories interweave a compelling tale of perseverance and determination.

programme.title: Animals In Superstition
programme.desc: We humans are a funny bunch with our superstitions and beliefs – and many of these involve animals.

programme.title: Echo And The Elephants Of Amboseli S1 - "Saved by the Rains"
programme.desc: On the plains of Amboseli, the rains are two months late. Echo brings the family to the palms to eat the last leaves. The wise matriarch resists the temptation to take them to inhabited areas where fresh crops are springing up and conflict waits.

programme.title: Echo And The Elephants Of Amboseli S1 - "Playtime"
programme.desc: In the relentless drought, the youngest calves are starving. Hunger is driving elephants to forage on surrounding farms. Echo’s keeps her family to the swamp. Rains arrive, but after five days, the much-needed downpours dwindle to sparse showers.

programme.title: Echo And The Elephants Of Amboseli S1 - "Clash of the Titans"
programme.desc: The rains bring new life. Lush new grass is saving the 58 elephant families from hunger. An extraordinary annual reunion brings hundreds of elephants together in scenes of celebration, play and romance.

programme.title: Monkey Thieves S1 - "The Apartment Job"
programme.desc: A fruitful break-in puts food on the table but ends in disaster when one of the troop gets a huge shock on an electricity pylon.

programme.title: Monkey Thieves S1 - "Fang’s Market"
programme.desc: A raid on the city fruit market seems like easy pickings until a rival gang appears, lead by the meanest macaque in Jaipur.

programme.title: Monkey Thieves S1 - "The Monkey Catcher"
programme.desc: After a food raid goes wrong the monkey catcher strikes, a handful of the gang are captured and taken away in his van.

programme.title: Animal Science S1 - "Animals on the Farm"
programme.desc: Head down to the farm to uncover the science behind the cow’s four-chambered stomach. Discover the curious muscle condition that causes some goats to faint, and learn the real meaning behind the term “horsepower.”

programme.title: Animal Science S1 - "South America’s Coolest Creatures"
programme.desc: Spotlight on some of the most fascinating creatures from South America! Discover how the powerful jaws of the jaguar can crush bone, and learn why the Galápagos tortoise can grow to nearly 1,000 pounds.

programme.title: Return Of The Spider Monkeys
programme.desc: A baby spider monkey named Infinity was stolen from the forest. After a 7-year rehabilitation, she is ready to return to the wild. She joins a makeshift group of orphaned monkeys and her newborn baby.

programme.title: Quolls: Fast & Furious
programme.desc: Explore the life and habits of the elusive northern subspecies of the spotted-tailed quoll. Come with us on a journey into the personal life of this beautiful long-lost cousin of the Tasmanian tiger.

programme.title: Race of Life S1 - "Defenses"
programme.desc: Defense mechanisms vary widely, from hyena jaws to frog speed and spider silk. Winning life's race requires a strong defense against predators' advances.

programme.title: Race of Life S1 - "Underwater Predators"
programme.desc: In the depths of the ocean, predators reign supreme, from sharks to moray eels.

programme.title: Race of Life S1 - "Underwater Prey's Defenses"
programme.desc: Life in the ocean demands constant adaptation for survival. From camouflage to group safety, animals employ various strategies to evade predators and secure food.

programme.title: Ocean Vet S1 - "Sargasso Sea"
programme.desc: Follow the team as they collect samples for an exhibit that will educate local school children on the unique species and tiny life that lives within these golden rainforests of the ocean.

programme.title: Ocean Vet S1 - "Diaries"
programme.desc: The crew look back and reveal their favourite moments, close calls and toughest challenges, and we discover just exactly what it took for Neil to become Bermuda’s Ocean Vet.

programme.title: Animals at Work S1 - "Nellie Truffle Hunter"
programme.desc: Meet Nellie, a Sussex Spaniel who hopes to become a champion truffle hunter, and the world’s most intelligent fish, who performs nine tricks including playing basketball and soccer.

programme.title: Animals at Work S1 - "Kitty Gardening Pig"
programme.desc: Head to Nova Scotia, Canada, where Miss Kitty, a nine-month-old Tamworth pig, is joining her fellow porkers who plough the fields with their snouts.

programme.title: The Re-Inventors
programme.desc: Can Matt and Jeremy get this bizarre one-wheeled bike in gear, or will hey need to put the brakes on the whole thing?

programme.title: The Re-Inventors
programme.desc: Rockets, 100 pounds os explosives, and a "wheel of fiery death". For the Re-Inventors it's just another day, another danger.

programme.title: Ultimate Processes
programme.desc: Francesca Chiorando is in the UK to visit custom electric guitar makers Crimson Guitars and the iconic Marshall Amplification factory in Milton Keynes.

programme.title: Ultimate Processes
programme.desc: Francesca Chiorando hits the racetrack for a test drive in one of the fastest motorsport cars in the world, a hand-built Prodrive Aston Martin.

programme.title: Ultimate Processes
programme.desc: In this episode Francesca Chiorando goes inside the largest tractor factory in the UK to see how they build their newest bespoke tractor.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Icy Gems: Frozen Moons
programme.desc: In the far depths of space, out of reach of the Sun's warmth, water can only exist in a super solid state. Some small moons, in fact, are made entirely of ice. What stories do these Icy Gems have to tell about our solar system?

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Shooting Gallery: Asteroids and Comets
programme.desc: Scientist long thought that our solar system consisted of the sun, the planets, and their moons. We soon found that we are far from alone, often coming into contact with asteroids, comets, and other debris.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Galactic Visions: Alien Worlds
programme.desc: The diversity, complexity, and downright beauty of our own solar system is astounding. Could such beauty exist in other parts of the universe as well? Thanks to modern science, we now have the capability to see for ourselves.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Mars: Red Dawn
programme.desc: Landing a spacecraft on Mars is no easy task given our limited knowledge of the planet. The difference between success and failure can rely on the most minute detail.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Giant Planets: Lords of Gravity
programme.sub-title: The Giant Planets: Lords of Gravity
programme.desc: Gravity is one of the most basic and powerful forces shaping our universe. Discover its nature within our own solar system, from the smallest moons to the largest planets.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Outer Limits: Edge of the Solar System
programme.sub-title: Outer Limits: Edge of the Solar System
programme.desc: For centuries, it was was thought that Saturn was the most distant planet in our Solar System. With the evolution of the telescope, we discovered the rest of our planets, both elusive and mysterious.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Borderland
programme.desc: Deserts and dunes, cliffs and canyons. Although Mars is certainly an alien wasteland, it is a planet with terrestrial formations remarkably similar to those found on Earth.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Silent Partner
programme.desc: Although we have put man on the moon, our silent partner still holds many mysteries. What haven't we seen? What haven't we discovered?

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Rocky Shores
programme.desc: The arid shores of other planets tell the stories of their past. What did they look like, and could they have ever supported life?

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Fountain of Creation
programme.desc: Without the Sun's warmth and light, life as we know it would not exist. It is the powerhouse of our planet and provides the energy we need to survive.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Windows to Other Worlds S1 Ep1
programme.sub-title: Windows to Other Worlds S1 Ep1
programme.desc: As technology has advanced, we have been able to peer into distant reaches of space. From the first telescopes to high-tech satellites, these machines have been our windows to other worlds.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Night Fire
programme.desc: The Northern Lights are more than just beautiful; they tell us about the make up of our planet, our sun, and may even be a signpost for the possibility of life on other planets.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Virtual Universe
programme.desc: Our understanding of the cosmos is limited by the amount of time we have to see it. Fortunately, computer simulations can help us see how galaxies interact over millions of years, and even how dark matter structures the universe.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Stargazer's Paradise
programme.desc: The Atacama desert is a perfect place for watching the night sky. With still winds and only a handful of cloudy nights each year, it allows scientists to get the absolute most out of their tools.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Hubble's Renaissance
programme.desc: Before we can reach space, we must first be able to see it. Hundreds of years ago, the simple telescope was used to give us a seemingly closer vantage. Today, we use the awe-inspiring, and super powerful, Hubble Space Telescope.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Superscopes
programme.desc: Discover the most powerful telescopes on the planet as they search for the mysteries of the universe.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rainbow
programme.desc: The human eye can only see visible light, a small spectrum of electromagnetic waves. Today, we have instruments that let us perceive all wavelengths.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Seasons of Saturn
programme.desc: Saturn is the second largest planet and has an astonishing 60 moons in its orbit. Thanks to the Cassini mission, it’s also one of the most studied and most photographed planets in our neighborhood.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Vesta Unveiled
programme.desc: With the Dawn missions exploration of the asteroid Vesta and the dwarf planet Ceres, asteroids are a hot topic. See what these incredible missions have uncovered.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Water Worlds
programme.desc: They key ingredient to life in the universe is water. Until recently we thought Earth was the only place in the solar system to have any water at all. Now that probes are peering around nearby worlds we are finding that is just not the case.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Gravity
programme.desc: Gravity has long been a force that has intrigued scientists. Now, for the first time scientists are probing to detect gravity waves in space as well as mapping the gravity patterns of the moon.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Science and the Shuttle
programme.desc: For more than 25 years the shuttle was our ticket to space, and our laboratory in orbit. Uncover the legacy of this amazing machine, and see what lies ahead.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landing on Mars
programme.desc: Mars sparks our curiosity like no other planet because it is so reachable. Despite having landed there, most of the information we gather is still done by instruments in the planet's orbit.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Milky Way
programme.desc: This episode traces our view of the Milky Way, from the mythology of ancient skywatchers to the efforts of scientists to map it from the inside out.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Big Bang
programme.desc: When it comes to the birth of the universe, not even the most creative work of imagination can rival what science has revealed about the Big Bang.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Hot Zone
programme.desc: Mercury is one of Earth's closest neighbors, but until very recent exploratory missions, it eluded astronomers' best efforts to learn its secrets.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rays
programme.desc: Cosmic rays can tell us much about the universe. They are not simply another form of light, but carriers of information about powerful and unseen processes at work thousands or even millions of light years away.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Fermi Paradox
programme.desc: The Fermi Paradox asks the ultimate question: why have alien civilizations not presented themselves?

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landsat
programme.desc: An advanced $900 million planetary explorer designed to peer across multiple wavelengths to reveal intricate details undetectable by the human eye.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Eye of the Beholder
programme.desc: The night sky has always been a source of wonder and mystery. In the quest to explore the universe, our greatest ally is the Hubble telescope.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Painted By Light

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Colour

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: Meet The Marsupials
programme.desc: Few countries have a more iconic representative in the animal kingdom than Australia and the marsupial. Marsupials were once found across the planet, but over time they found their way to the outback, leaving Australia as an ark carrying the future of pouch mammals. As varied as they are unusual, marsupials are a weird and wonderful mob of animals who carry their young in a pouch. Whether hopping, climbing or even airborne, marsupials are some of the strangest but most fascinating creatures you're likely to meet.

programme.title: Rainforest Home
programme.desc: Rainforest, teeming with millions of dramatic plants and animals, home to some of the most astonishing animal families you're likely to find.

programme.title: Masked Bandits
programme.desc: The masked bandits come with a reputation for trouble and mischief, and while they're certainly cunning and creative, they're also social, loyal and cuddly! From red pandas and badgers to coatis and, of course, raccoons – we'll cast any animal with a stripe across their eyes as pesky troublemakers. Take a moment to look past their robber masks and you'll find a remarkable set of creatures with stories you'll find nowhere else in the animal kingdom. It's time to lift the veil on the masked bandits!

programme.title: History of Life on Earth Journey To The Land
programme.desc: As the first landmasses emerged from prehistoric seas, animals took their first steps on dry land. The explosion of life that followed changed the world forever.

programme.title: Fighting for a Mate
programme.desc: Animals face daily battles to protect themselves and secure the resources they need to survive. Every battle is a trade-off between the risk to health and the prizes awarded to the victors. Each animal fights with a unique set of tools, from display structures and elaborate body language to claws, jaws and antlers.
